label: Syntax and elaboration gates
subgoals: Parse and elaborate each generated property against the RTL
Treat errors and tool warnings as failures fed back to the model
Keep generated properties in a bind file outside the RTL

label: Vacuity and covers
subgoals: Cover the antecedent of every generated implication
Re-check the reference covers under any generated assumption
Reject properties that pass only vacuously

label: Does the assertion have teeth
subgoals: Mutate the RTL and re-run the prover on each mutant
Count the mutants each property kills
Prove a generated property equivalent to a reference with a miter of monitors
